dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Smoothly concave trailing edge following a continuous inward-curving spline from the apex to the posterior base insertion.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Narrowly rounded apex classification with a small pixel radius and high curvature.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: High angular steepness, measured at approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Near 1:1 ratio between the maximum vertical pixel height and the longitudinal base width.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Uniformly convex melon with a medium-radius circular arc extending from the dorsal transition to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick beak geometry exhibiting a low length-to-width pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse inflection point at the melon-rostrum junction, measuring approximately 130 degrees.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable bright, circular reflective or pigmented patch located on the distal third of the visible pectoral fin; no distinct notches or nicks are visible on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Monochromatic cyan-teal spectral luminance across the entire cutaneous surface with sharp silhouette contrast against a black background.
